report.scene_summary: The video shows an industrial manufacturing floor with hydraulic presses and a forklift transporting stacked orange bins. A worker is seated at a workstation on the right side. The forklift moves through the central aisle, passing the worker and the machinery. The floor is marked with yellow lines indicating a path or boundary.

findings.title: Forklift operating near seated worker
findings.location: Central aisle, right side near workstation
findings.observation: A forklift carrying a load of orange bins is observed moving through the aisle in close proximity to a worker seated at a workstation. The forklift passes within a few feet of the worker.
findings.risk_interpretation: The proximity of a moving heavy vehicle to a stationary worker creates a risk of collision or injury from falling objects. The worker is seated and may have limited mobility or awareness.
findings.applicability_reason: The forklift is a mechanical handling equipment using an aisle/passageway. The standard requires safe clearances and keeping aisles clear.
unknowns: Whether the path is a designated pedestrian walkway or a shared aisle
recommended_actions: Verify that the aisle width and layout provide adequate clearance for forklifts and pedestrians.
Ensure the forklift operator maintains a safe distance from the worker.
Consider physical barriers or designated pedestrian walkways if the area is high-traffic.
Confirm the worker is wearing appropriate PPE.

findings.title: Unsecured red bin/cart near machinery
findings.location: Near the blue and white hydraulic press on the right
findings.observation: A red bin or small cart is positioned on the floor near the base of a hydraulic press. It appears stationary but is not clearly secured.
findings.risk_interpretation: If the bin is not secured, it could be knocked over by the forklift or machinery vibration, creating a tripping hazard or obstruction.
findings.applicability_reason: Materials must be stored so they do not create hazards. An unsecured object near active machinery fits this description.
unknowns: Whether the bin is intended to be there
If it is secured or just placed
recommended_actions: Inspect the red bin/cart to ensure it is stable and not a tripping hazard.
Secure the bin or relocate it to a designated storage area if not in use.

dismissed.reason: The forklift is operating in the designated aisle. While it is a hazard to the worker nearby, it is not an obstruction of the aisle itself in the sense of blocking it permanently.
There are dark stains on the floor, but they appear to be oil or grease stains rather than a fresh spill. No active leaking is observed.
